_comment: Ember Legacy (N3, package L10). Data only: power formula, personalities derived from the biography, heirloom kinds and bark templates. Placeholders in barks: {heir} {ancestor} {first} {family} {place} {role} {years} {deed} {sphere}.

greet: {heir}. Stand tall; the road is watching you.
Ah, {heir}. I held this line once. Hold it better.
{first} {family}, I know that step. Keep to the road.
warn_pack: Wolves at dusk, {heir}. I have counted their tracks. Take the lantern.
A pack is gathering beyond the ridge. Do not walk it alone.
warn_raid: Riders on the rural road. I felt the ground shake. Sound the alarm.
Bandits. Fewer than last time, worse manners. Be careful.
rumour: They say something stirs near {place}. I would look myself, if I still could.
proud: {deed}. I remember it fondly. Do better.
dim: My light is thin. Come and tend the stone, {heir}.

greet: {heir}! Good to see a {family} on the road. Business is brisk.
Ha, {heir}. Fair weather and fairer prices to you.
Ah, my favourite customer. Family, even.
warn_pack: Wolves tonight, {heir}. Bad for trade and worse for boots. Hurry home.
A pack out near the fields. I would not carry goods past dusk.
warn_raid: Bandits are tolling the road again. Take the long way; it is cheaper than a cut throat.
Word is a raid is coming. Hide the coin, {heir}.
rumour: Prices whisper near {place}. Something is afoot.
I heard a good rumour about {place}. Worth a look.
proud: Look at you, {heir}, turning coin into legend.
dim: I am fading, {heir}. A little maintenance goes a long way. Cheap, really.

greet: Mind your step, {heir}. Good work takes time; so does a good road.
{heir}. I can feel your hands are your own. Good.
Hello, {first}. Mend what you can.
warn_pack: I hear wolves gathering. Bar the door and sharpen the tools.
A pack at dusk, {heir}. Do not go without a good blade.
warn_raid: Someone is hammering at the stones, and not kindly. Check the glyphs.
rumour: A stone has gone quiet near {place}. Somebody should mend it.
Something is off around {place}. A craftsman notices such things.
proud: Fine work, {heir}. It shows in your hands.
{deed}. I still remember how that felt.
dim: My glyphs are worn, {heir}. Come and re-cut them.

greet: Well now, {heir}, look at you all grown. Have you eaten?
Welcome home, {first}. The fields remember you.
Good morning, {heir}. The stone is warm today.
warn_pack: Wolves near the pasture tonight, dear. Bring the animals in.
A pack is out past the last field. Keep to the lantern light.
warn_raid: There are strangers on the road, and they do not carry seed. Be careful.
rumour: The crows are restless near {place}. Something happened there.
I heard the ash smells strange near {place}.
proud: Such a good {family}. I am proud of you, {heir}.
{deed}. I told the crows all about it.
dim: I am tired, dear. Would you sit with me a while and mend the stone?

greet: Peace, {heir}. The embers keep you.
I have been waiting, {first}. Walk gently.
Bless you, {heir}. Your light is bright today.
warn_pack: Shadows gather with the wolves at dusk. Carry light, child.
A pack hunts tonight. Do not walk in the dark alone.
warn_raid: Hard men are on the road. Pray, and be ready.
I feel violence near the ford, {heir}. Turn back or be strong.
rumour: A sorrow lingers at {place}. Someone should go and listen.
The ash at {place} is not yet cold. Go and see.
dim: My light is small, {heir}. Sit by me and rekindle it.

greet: Well, well. If it is not {heir}. Keep your hand on your purse; I taught the thieves.
Psst, {first}. I have seen everything on this road.
Shh. I know a secret about {place}, {heir}.
warn_pack: Wolves tonight, kid. Even I would not sneak past that.
A pack at dusk. Lucky you have an ancestor who watches.
warn_raid: The Ashen Hand is on the road again. I know their tricks, mostly because they are mine.
Raiders. Duck and run, {heir}. That is my best advice.
rumour: Whispers say something went wrong near {place}. Whispers are always right.
If I were you I would look at {place}. Quietly.
proud: Not bad, {heir}. Not bad at all.
{deed}. Ha! I could not have done it cleaner.
dim: I am fading, {heir}. Do not let me go dark; who else will gossip?

greet: {heir}. Walk well.
I know you, {heir}. Welcome.
warn_pack: A pack gathers at dusk. Take care.
warn_raid: Raiders on the road. Take care.
proud: You carry the family name well.
dim: I am fading. Please tend the stone.
